question: What HDPE material specifications do GCM Netting Solutions use for commercial projects in Chennai?
answer:
At GCM Netting Solutions in Chennai, we prioritize quality and durability in all our commercial project installations. Our HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene) safety nets meet stringent material specifications to ensure optimal performance and longevity. We use only virgin HDPE material, known for its high tensile strength, excellent impact resistance, and superior resistance to environmental degradation. This ensures the safety nets can withstand the rigors of construction sites and other commercial environments. The HDPE yarn we utilize has a specific gravity of 0.941-0.965 g/cm³ and a melting point range of 120-140°C.

Crucially, our HDPE nets are UV stabilized, protecting them from the harmful effects of prolonged sun exposure, which is particularly important in Chennai's climate. This UV stabilization significantly extends the lifespan of the safety nets, reducing the need for frequent replacements. We offer a warranty of 3-5 years on our safety nets, depending on the specific application and environmental conditions.
